transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. I, uh... I came in because most days I just wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling in my chest. I've always been in sales, so I'm used to being the guy who can talk to anybody, but lately... it's like the old Ruben is just gone. I just don't enjoy my days anymore.
Did this start after a specific stressful event or major change in your life?

Yeah, it actually did. This has been going on for about eight months now. We got a new regional manager around then, and he just started coming down on me... taking away accounts I’d handled for years. It's just been like this ever since.
If this situation with your new manager were resolved, do you think these feelings would mostly go away?

I honestly don't know. I mean, I'd like to think so, but... I'm just not sure anymore. It feels like it's gone a lot deeper than just the job at this point. Even if he left tomorrow and I got my old accounts back, I don't know if I'd just snap back to normal. I can't really picture feeling better, to be honest.
For the past couple of weeks, have you felt down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah, I have. Like I said earlier, it's just... most days I wake up with that heavy, hollow feeling right in my chest. It's there almost all the time. It just feels like the old me is completely gone.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I really have. I used to... well, I used to look forward to a lot of things. Bowling, working out in the garden, taking my wife to gallery shows, or even going dancing. But now... I just sit there. I find myself making excuses not to do any of it, because honestly, none of it even feels worth the effort anymore.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

Yes, I have. Um... I've been having these thoughts lately that maybe my wife and kids would just be better off if I didn't wake up. It's hard to even say out loud, but... those thoughts really scare me. They scare me enough that I just don't trust myself the way I used to.
Before this started eight months ago, have you ever had another period in your life when you felt depressed like this for days at a time?

No, I haven't. I mean, sure, I've had bad days or stressful weeks with work over the years, but... never anything like this. Before this started eight months ago, I've never felt this low or had it just stick around like this. This is the first time.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?

Yeah, sleep has been really tough. At night, I just lie there staring at the ceiling, replaying work stuff over and over in my head. And when I finally do manage to get to sleep, I end up waking up around three or four in the morning. I open my eyes and I'm just... already worn out. I wake up just dreading having to face the day.
Have you been feeling worthless?

Yeah, I have. I just... I keep telling myself that I'm useless now. It feels like all those years I spent taking care of my clients and providing for my family... like none of it even counts anymore, just because I can't even handle this job right now.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

No, I don't think so. I haven't really noticed any problems with my focus. I mean... if I actually need to sit down and read through some paperwork or something like that, I can still pay attention to it just fine. That part seems to be okay.
Have you noticed a big change in your appetite?
No, not really. I mean... my appetite seems pretty normal. I'm still eating like I usually do, so I haven't noticed any big changes with that.
Do you still feel this depressed on days when you're away from work, like on weekends or vacation days?
Yeah, it doesn't really matter if it's the weekend or a day off. I... I feel pretty much the same no matter what day it is. Being away from work doesn't really seem to make a difference.
